environment: Actual .NET 10 browser-wasm runtime hosted by Node

tests.name: Compile actual C# async System.IO program
Seed actual .NET WASM files, run C# and capture binary snapshots
Filesystem deltas report created, unchanged and deleted files accurately
Ephemeral executions have separate filesystem workspaces
Files are captured even when managed user code throws
Persistent workspace seeds files and exposes configured quotas
Invoke real managed methods with a persistent working filesystem
File-aware invocation preserves generic and exact-signature options
Workspace write, selected read, list and delete operate on runtime bytes
Absolute paths and traversal are rejected without host file writes
Persistent transfer validation is atomic for byte quotas and duplicate paths
Per-execution file count and generated output byte limits are enforced
Concurrent file-aware calls retain independent CWD, stdout and contents
Disposing a workspace invalidates its identifier
